nodes.label: Design Skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Unified design skill consolidating brand, tokens, UI, logo, CIP, slides, banners, icons, social photos into one routing entry point

nodes.label: Design System Skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Formalizes tokens and specs; consumes brand colors/typography, feeds ui-styling

nodes.label: Banner Design Skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Multi-format creative banner system generating multiple art direction options per request with AI-powered visuals; scoped to banner design only, excluding video editing, full website, and print production.

nodes.label: Brand Skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Owns brand identity, voice, and assets; upstream source of colors and typography

nodes.label: Ad Types
nodes.rationale: Ad types must differ: paid post/story/reel, barter, affiliate commission, visit-based QR, UGC.

nodes.label: Affiliate Links & Discount Codes
nodes.rationale: Auto-generate custom affiliate links or discount codes per creator to track actual sales.

nodes.label: AI-Generated Creator Bio/Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Bio generated from the creator profile via an AI agent.

nodes.label: Analytics & ROI Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Brands want to know what the ad achieved; platform pulls reach/engagement/clicks post-publish into a professional report.

nodes.label: Anonymous Brand Reviews
nodes.rationale: Creators anonymously write experiences with companies to warn fellow creators.

nodes.label: Barter Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Small businesses offer free products/services for an ad, documented by an in-app contract to guarantee the creator publishes.

nodes.label: Barter Digital Catalog
nodes.rationale: Companies upload products/services available for exchange so creators pick what suits them for content.

nodes.label: Brand/Merchant Actor
nodes.rationale: Signs up by phone only, then chooses company or store type, name, Facebook/Instagram, and industry.

nodes.label: Exclusive Brand Clubs
nodes.rationale: Creator joins a brand's elite list to get fixed monthly retainers as a permanent brand ambassador.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief Builder
nodes.rationale: Guides merchants who may not know how to request an ad to specify content type, mandatory keywords, and forbidden mentions.

nodes.label: Collab Network / Group Collaboration
nodes.rationale: Future feature letting two creators merge and submit a joint package for one campaign to increase acceptance.

nodes.label: Content Review System (Drafts)
nodes.rationale: Creator uploads video/image as a draft in-app instead of sending via WhatsApp (which reduces quality), so brand can review and approve before publishing.

nodes.label: Automated Contracts
nodes.rationale: On approval, platform generates a simplified legal PDF contract (publish date, story duration, refund terms) to prevent disputes and protect both parties.

nodes.label: Creator Actor
nodes.rationale: Requires a professional (Creator or Business) account linked to a Facebook page; signs up by phone only.

nodes.label: Dispute Resolution
nodes.rationale: All agreement and publishing must happen in-app so records are reviewable by support when a dispute arises.

nodes.label: Dynamic Profiles
nodes.rationale: Replaces traditional portfolio by linking social accounts to surface real engagement stats and audience segmentation automatically.

nodes.label: Escrow System
nodes.rationale: Trust and money is the biggest pain point; brand pays platform upfront, funds held until creator publishes and system confirms, then released.

nodes.label: Escrow Fund Release Split
nodes.rationale: Deposited ad amount is frozen; 30% transferred on start, remainder released after publish minus the platform's percentage commission.

nodes.label: Free Launch Then Commission Strategy
nodes.rationale: Offer service fully free at first to organize the market and attract sign-ups, then gradually activate commissions once users depend on the platform.

nodes.label: Hyper-Local Filtering
nodes.rationale: Search creators by governorate/city — essential for physical restaurants and shops.

nodes.label: Instant Cash-out
nodes.rationale: Creator withdraws earnings instantly to Sham Cash for a small fee instead of waiting for the usual weekly transfer.

nodes.label: Local E-Wallet Payment Integration
nodes.rationale: Brand tops up via local payment services (e.g. Syriatel Cash, Sham Cash) sending to the platform wallet number.

nodes.label: Local Rate Index
nodes.rationale: Shows creators the prevailing market average for similar creator tiers (without revealing identities) so they don't underprice.

nodes.label: Smart Matchmaking
nodes.rationale: System recommends best-fit creators from campaign details, or lets creators apply to open campaigns like freelance platforms.

nodes.label: Notification Settings & City Alerts
nodes.rationale: Alert creators in the same city to apply quickly after a client posts a campaign; configurable notification receiving.

nodes.label: Offline Event Booking
nodes.rationale: Companies book a creator by the hour to attend a store opening, ribbon-cutting, or live on-ground event coverage with an hourly rate.

nodes.label: Deal Pipeline / State Machine
nodes.rationale: Turns the ad-hoc agreement into ordered programmatic states to prevent overlap or tampering.

nodes.label: Sada All-in-One Creator Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Market is fragmented; creators and brands juggle email, WhatsApp, analytics and payment apps for one deal — consolidating into one platform is the core value.

nodes.label: Profile Comparison Matrix
nodes.rationale: Lets a client compare up to 3 creators' numbers, prices and engagement on one chart before hiring.

nodes.label: Proof-of-Publish Link Verification
nodes.rationale: Creator submits post/story link as proof; system verifies it, then releases escrow funds.

nodes.label: Visit-Based QR Tracking
nodes.rationale: Generate a creator-specific QR that customers scan for a discount so the merchant knows how many visits the creator drove.

nodes.label: Saved Rate Cards
nodes.rationale: Save preset price packages (e.g. 3 stories bundle, reel+story) to send clients with one tap.

nodes.label: Refund Pipeline
nodes.rationale: If creator breaches or delays publishing, funds auto-return to the merchant wallet without argument.

nodes.label: Smart Rate Calculator
nodes.rationale: Future tool suggesting a fair price based on real views and market demand so creators don't undersell.

nodes.label: UGC Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Hire creators to shoot videos/products without publishing on the creator's account, for the brand to use as its own paid ads.

nodes.label: Vacation Mode
nodes.rationale: Temporarily stop receiving offers and notify companies of absence without hurting ranking or rating.

nodes.label: Digital Wallet
nodes.rationale: Both parties need a wallet; brands deposit and pay, creators withdraw only.

nodes.label: Motion / Duration
nodes.rationale: Semantic durations alias raw duration values

nodes.label: Spacing Scale
nodes.rationale: 4px base unit system

nodes.label: Status Colors
nodes.rationale: Info color aliases the blue primary scale via var reference

nodes.label: Primitive Tokens
nodes.rationale: Raw design values serving as the foundation layer of a three-layer token architecture (primitive→semantic→component)

nodes.label: Icon Design (Built-in)
